subject.title: fix(skills): coding-agent completion works with SecretRef auth

question: Should bundled coding-agent workers under restricted sandboxes permanently delegate completion and failure delivery to the authenticated parent, with no supported worker-owned notification route?
rationale: The change deliberately establishes a cross-worker security and message-delivery contract for Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode; source text alone cannot determine whether maintainers intend to preserve an alternative worker-owned capability.

options.title: Adopt parent-owned delivery
options.body: Make the authenticated parent the sole delivery owner and require live proof that the real parent path sends one success and one failure notification.

options.title: Preserve a worker capability
options.body: Define and implement a narrowly scoped worker notification capability that does not expose the parent Gateway credential.

recommendation.title: Adopt parent-owned delivery
recommendation.body: Make the authenticated parent the sole delivery owner and require live proof that the real parent path sends one success and one failure notification.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged Codex environment-isolation work is the closest concrete history signal available for the external-worker boundary.
